title: Text summary
decider: No one: the summary is written on its own
description: When someone pastes a text into the page, the configured AI model writes a short factual summary of it. The page shows the summary with the model that wrote it and the tokens it used, and marks one the model cut short. A blank or too long text is refused before any paid request, and a refused or failed answer is shown with what went wrong instead of a summary.

card.title: Text summary
card.summary: A page where a person submits a text and gets a short factual summary from the configured AI model, with the model and token usage shown.

features.text: A blank, too long or invalid text is refused before any model request, and the refused submission starts no summary.
A repeated submission with the same request ID starts one summary.
The configured model writes a short factual summary, which the page shows with the model and token usage; a summary cut at the output limit is shown as truncated.
A blocked, rejected, invalid or failed model answer shows its status and a notice and no summary.
A lost model response is recorded as unknown without sending the paid request again.

connections.user_setup: Configure the summary-model connection with a provider key and a model in Studio Configuration.

acceptance: A submitted text shows its summary, the model and the token usage on the page, and its run completes in Studio.

design.summary: One text is validated, summarized by the configured model and saved with the model and its token usage; every other answer is recorded with a notice.

flows.purpose: Summarizes one text with one paid model request and keeps the result.

steps.explanation: Validate and keep the text before any paid model request.

next.when: the text is empty, too long or not UTF-8

steps.explanation: Ask the configured model for a short factual summary.

next.when: blocked, rejected, invalid or a defect

steps.explanation: Save the summary, the model and the token usage.
Record why the model returned no usable summary.
Record a lost model response without sending the paid request again.

attributes.name: SummaryStatus
attributes.value: pending, generating, completed, truncated, blocked, provider_rejected, invalid_response, defect, invalid_input or unknown

title: GitHub releases newsletter
description: Visitors subscribe once with their email address on the page. When an administrator posts publish newsletter in the Slack channel, the process reads the last seven days of releases of two GitHub repositories, has OpenAI write one factual report, and sends it to every subscriber as their own Gmail message. A failed read or model answer sends nothing, and an uncertain send is never repeated.

card.title: GitHub Releases Newsletter
card.summary: Visitors subscribe once; an authorized Slack message starts a release newsletter and each subscriber receives an individual Gmail delivery.

features.text: The public page accepts valid email subscriptions, retains each normalized address once and gives clear feedback.
Only a selected administrator posting the exact top-level Slack message publish newsletter in the selected channel starts a campaign; duplicate delivery of that message starts none.
The campaign reads every release page from superdurable/dex and dex-connectors-library, excludes drafts, filters by the previous seven days and keeps original links.
OpenAI writes a factual newsletter from release notes, or the report clearly says there are no releases; source or model failure never sends an incomplete report.
The campaign freezes subscribers at trigger time; Gmail sends the same report to each individually and records sent, failed or uncertain delivery without automatically retrying an uncertain send.

connections.user_setup: Authorize Slack, select the channel and administrator members in Studio.
Authorize GitHub access to the two repositories.
Configure the OpenAI key and model.

user_setup: Invite the Slack app to the publishing channel and configure four TeamSpace connections.
acceptance: A subscribed test address receives a Gmail message after the authorized Slack command, and the campaign reports a successful delivery.

design.summary: Visitors subscribe once; an administrator's Slack message starts a campaign that reads two repositories' releases, writes one report with OpenAI and sends it to each frozen subscriber by Gmail.

title: Slack thread approval
decider: The members allowed to reply in the thread
description: When someone posts a new message in the approval channel in Slack, a process starts for that thread and waits. The first reply in the thread from one of the members allowed to approve finishes it: the process posts “Processing complete.” in the thread. Later replies change nothing, and a message Slack delivers twice starts only one process.

card.title: Slack thread approval
card.summary: A process that follows threads in one Slack channel: a new message starts it, and a reply in its thread finishes it with a confirmation posted in the thread.

features.text: A new top-level message in the configured Slack channel starts one approval for its thread; a redelivered message starts no second one.
The first matching reply in that thread is accepted and moves the approval on; a later reply changes nothing.
After the reply, the application posts Processing complete. into the same thread and completes the approval.

connections.need: Receive new channel messages and thread replies, and reply in the thread
connections.user_setup: Select the TeamSpace Slack connection as slack-approvals, then choose the channel and the members allowed to reply for both triggers in Studio Configuration.

user_setup: Invite the platform's Slack app to the approval channel.
acceptance: A new message in the channel starts a run in Studio that waits for a reply.
A reply in its thread makes the application post Processing complete. in the thread, and the run completes.

design.summary: A process that follows threads in one Slack channel: a new message starts it, and a reply in its thread finishes it with a confirmation posted in the thread.

flows.purpose: Follows one Slack thread: its root message starts the Flow, the first matching reply posts the completion reply and ends it.

steps.explanation: Keep the Slack thread that the new channel message started and wait for a reply in it.

next.when: the first matching reply arrives in the thread (ReceiveThreadReply)

steps.explanation: Post Processing complete. into the thread once a matching reply arrived.

next.when: Slack rejects the reply, a defect, or the outcome is unknown

steps.explanation: Complete once Slack confirms the completion reply.
Record why the completion reply was not confirmed, without posting it again.

title: Summary approval
description: When someone pastes a text into the page, the configured AI model writes a short summary of it, and the summary waits for a person to approve it in Studio before it is saved. A truncated summary is saved without waiting, and a blocked, refused or failed answer is recorded with what went wrong instead of a summary.

card.title: Summary approval
card.summary: A person approves each generated summary in Studio before it is saved.

features.text: A Step AwaitSummaryApproval holds the generated summary and shows awaiting-approval until a person decides.
An Approve summary Action releases that Step, which then saves the summary.

acceptance: The summary is saved only after Approve summary is chosen in a Studio run.

design.summary: The summary run waits after generation until a person approves it in Studio; then it is saved.

flows.purpose: Summarizes a text with a model and saves it once a person approves.

steps.explanation: Validate and keep the text before any paid model request.

next.when: the text is empty, too long or not UTF-8

steps.explanation: Ask the configured model for a short factual summary.

next.when: blocked, rejected, invalid or a defect

steps.explanation: Wait for a person to approve the generated summary before it is saved.
Save the summary, the model and the token usage.
Record why the model returned no usable summary.
Record a lost model response without sending the paid request again.
